# Guides

Guides are process notes, checklists, and thinking aids. They are useful context, but they are not hard rules.

Suggested frontmatter:

```yaml
---
id: example-guide
title: Example Guide
type: guide
appliesTo:
  - all
---
```

Use guides for review checklists, UI heuristics, research notes, migration playbooks, and other guidance that should inform judgment without becoming a strict validator.
